lines.para: Graphics chips have become the oil of the 21st century: without them, there is no artificial intelligence. Since 2022, Washington has restricted their export to China. American manufacturers design scaled-down versions; Beijing looks for other routes, and middlemen in Asia are suspected of diverting shipments.

On 29 October 2026, the New York Times reports that US intelligence suspects a Chinese businesswoman, head of a data-centre company based in Singapore, of spying for Beijing. She had close ties with the head of Nvidia. The White House is said to have been told a year earlier, and done nothing.
Nvidia denies any wrongdoing. Nothing shows that its CEO knew anything at all.
A story that is only just beginning.
